definition: One Knowledge Base Retrieve per gate message through BedrockKnowledgeBaseRetriever with production settings (course_material_id filter, candidate count, validation of bucket, key and text). top_score is the highest score among validated chunks, or null when none survived; result_count is the number of validated chunks kept (at most max_results); raw_hit_count is what Retrieve returned before validation; elapsed_ms is measured around the adapter call. A failed or empty call is recorded with its status and failure_category. Rows carry ids and categories only, no message or history text.
